Messages.Author: Ian
Messages.Body:
When can sudden reversal be played?
I was under the impression that it
was intended to be a counterspell
type card, but some people tend
to think that it can be used at any
time.

Thanx
IW

Messages.Author: Jonathan Yen
Messages.Body:
In article <D0CrC...@undergrad.math.uwaterloo.ca>,


sudden reversal can be played at any time because it is a master out-of-phase
card. however, you have to give up your next master phase in lieu of using
this card. so, don't think this card doesn't have a drawback cuz it does,
albeit a small one in regards to what it can do.

Jonathan

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Sudden Reversal can only burn a master card just played, not one which has
been sitting around in play for a while. The ruling on this used to be
the opposite, which is probably what's causing the confusion.
